<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen-api-reference.ts from sdk/openapi.json. Do not edit — including in Studio; the next build replaces this file. -->

::api-operation{method="POST" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/integrations/hubspot/conflicts/{id}/resolve"}
#docs
`ours` queues a push of our values to HubSpot. `theirs` reads the record from HubSpot and applies its current values for the conflicting fields here. Either way the record syncs normally again.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |
| `id` | `string` | **yes** | The conflict's id. |

## Headers

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Idempotency-Key` | `string` | no | Safely retry writes — repeats return the original response. If a write FAILED after it had already taken effect, that failure is what repeats: the key is spent, and a new attempt needs a new key. |

## Body

The request body is **required**.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `keep` | `string` | **yes** | Which value to keep: `ours` or `theirs`. One of `ours`, `theirs`. |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type. |
| `id` | `string` | The conflict's id (hscf_…). |
| `status` | `string` | The conflict's status. One of `open`, `resolved`. |
| `local_type` | `string` | The type of our record: `customer` or `subscription`. One of `customer`, `subscription`. |
| `local_id` | `string` | Our record's public id. |
| `remote_type` | `string` | The type of the HubSpot record. One of `contact`, `company`, `deal`. |
| `remote_id` | `string` | The id of the HubSpot record. |
| `fields` | `array of object` | The fields. |
| `remote_updated_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the HubSpot record was last changed (ISO-8601 UTC). |
| `detected_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the conflict was found (ISO-8601 UTC). |
| `resolution` | `string` | Which value was kept: `ours` or `theirs`. Null while unresolved. One of `ours`, `theirs`. |
| `resolved_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the conflict was resolved (ISO-8601 UTC), or null. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | The resolved conflict |
| `400` | Invalid body, or HubSpot needs reconnecting to take its values |
| `404` | No such conflict, or HubSpot is not connected |
| `409` | The conflict was already resolved |
| `502` | HubSpot refused the request |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl -X POST "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/integrations/hubspot/conflicts/XXXXXXXXXXXX01/resolve" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "keep": "ours"
  }'
```
